title: Activity 4 feedback: schema/role documentation and missing constraint test
body:
Database initialization, application workflows and restricted-account verification worked in our Activity 4 environment.

Please align docs/user_roles.md with the actual school_event_management_db schema and PostgreSQL role/account setup. docs/testing.md also references a test_constraints.sql file that we could not find in the tested main ZIP snapshot.

Our test environment used separate NOLOGIN privilege groups and project-account connection restrictions without changing application source. This feedback concerns documentation reproducibility; no application workflow failure is claimed here.

Evidence will be consolidated under https://github.com/louisandreidg/Batumbakal-Gym/tree/main/db-access-control/final/group-02 .

title: Activity 4 feedback: cashier workflow tests use missing handler paths
body:
Tested main snapshot 8fab8f7. PostgreSQL migrations/seed and authenticated Manager pages worked. This supersedes our earlier assessment of the older MySQL-based snapshot.

The supplied CashierWorkflow test suite reports failures and references missing handlers such as admin/queue.php, admin/process_walkin.php and admin/update_order.php; current handlers are under backend/api and admin/cashier. The runner exits with status zero even while reporting failures, so relying on the exit code hides the failure.

Please update the suite to the current routes, verify the remaining workflow/CSRF failures, and make the runner return a nonzero exit status when assertions fail. We have not claimed the failing cashier workflow suite passed. The README also retains older MySQL setup statements despite the current PDO/PostgreSQL implementation.

Raw setup, HTTP and workflow-test evidence will be consolidated at https://github.com/louisandreidg/Batumbakal-Gym/tree/main/db-access-control/final/group-05 . Application source was unchanged.

title: Activity 4 feedback: schema creates payment foreign key before staff primary key
body:
On a fresh PostgreSQL database, the supplied schema stopped at payment_received_by_fkey: its referenced staff primary key is declared later in the dump. In our tested snapshot, the foreign key is around line 859 and staff_pkey around line 907.

We added the staff primary key before the foreign key in a separate local resume script, then resumed the remaining original schema without deleting existing data. The original application source stayed unchanged. Application startup, login, vehicle create/update/delete and restricted database permissions then worked.

Please reorder the staff primary-key declaration before dependent foreign keys so a clean schema import completes in one run.

The initial failure and corrected resume output will be consolidated at https://github.com/louisandreidg/Batumbakal-Gym/tree/main/db-access-control/final/group-06 .

title: Activity 4 feedback: provision session storage and narrow reporting grants
body:
PostgreSQL setup, admin/customer authentication, package CRUD and booking flows worked in our Activity 4 environment.

For a runtime account without schema CREATE, session storage needs to be provisioned by the database owner before starting the application. We precreated the connect-pg-simple session table and granted its runtime operations instead of widening runtime schema privileges.

The supplied broad read-only grants also exposed password_hash columns in customer/admin. We revoked those table-wide SELECT grants for the reporting group and granted approved columns. Please document or incorporate equivalent reporting restrictions.

Identity-based package INSERT already worked before an explicit sequence grant was added; we are not reporting a sequence-permission failure.

Evidence and local setup adaptations will be consolidated at https://github.com/louisandreidg/Batumbakal-Gym/tree/main/db-access-control/final/group-08 . No application source changes were made.

title: Activity 4 feedback: dashboard cancellation and documented role mismatches
body:
Tested main c3b916a080f3201567f467a456d55c74b9ca3ba8 with the documented restricted PostgreSQL accounts. Initialization, login, organization/event creation, registration and database privilege checks worked.

Confirmed issues:

- Dashboard cancellation calls php/app/dashboard/cancel_registration.php, which physically DELETEs registration. The documented runtime group lacks DELETE, and authenticated cancellation returned HTTP 500. The event-page unregister action uses an allowed soft delete and worked. Please use a consistent soft-delete policy rather than widening runtime DELETE.
- README limits organization-detail editing to organization Admins, but update_organization.php accepts Admin or Manager. After promotion through the normal workflow, the Manager successfully changed university_name. Please align implementation and documentation.
- With PHP output buffering off, leading output before login headers caused header/session-regeneration warnings and corrupted JSON. The same credentials worked with normal buffering enabled. Please remove leading output and keep warnings out of API responses.

Raw responses, application outcomes and SQL evidence will be consolidated at https://github.com/louisandreidg/Batumbakal-Gym/tree/main/db-access-control/final/group-10 . Source was unchanged.
